findings.evidence: TailStop.choose receives only model, PublicState and public Config. It simulates after_skip, retaining h.copy, and stops simulation at the first READ. It never calls World.read, samples hypothetical outcomes, or accesses hidden labels or teacher posterior.

With deterministic decision-state-free policy, unchanged content h during SKIP, STOP prediction determined by h, and nonnegative SKIP tariff, the transformation removes only a terminal SKIP-to-STOP tail. Real READ slots, observations, accepted READ successors and terminal classification are preserved pathwise. Utility improvement equals the removed SKIP tariff.

dominance.py computes continuation reads/skips/correctness by reverse history recursion under each frozen chosen policy, checks both utility decompositions and equality of correctness/read counts at every history, and verifies improvement equals reduced SKIP tariff. run.py writes these continuation statistics in raw state evidence.

Both cores retain lightweight, original_qstar, matched_qstar and qpi_selected alongside their four TailStop transformations. Worlds share the same seed/configuration across cores and all eight controls; within-world execution order rotates. All four designated factorials are retained.

The inherited executor times controller.choose around the entire wrapper, including extra policy calls. Actor totals and per-stage controller CPU are nested within the new fresh-child process receipt. World generation/evidence serialization are outer costs, not silently added to actor timing twice.

The wrapper returns unchanged trained scores, while evaluate_policy recomputes Qpi for the actually executed transformed policy. No claim that the transformed actor is argmax of its unchanged original scores is needed. Residual ranking/scale errors remain measurable.

All 10 current source hashes and 107 inherited input hashes match the fixed manifest. The parent remote-readback receipt at the stated commit covers all source entries and SOURCE_FREEZE itself. No code or inherited artifact was modified by this reviewer.

limitations: This is source/proof review only, not independent reproduction of confirmation results, a training rerun, or a claim all numerical outputs pass.
The proof does not apply to dynamics where waiting changes h, terminal utility depends on deadline, or controller decision state mutates.
Actual forced-prefix validation covers root and one occupied intermediate prefix; it is distinct from all-history Bellman checks.
The inherited 161.158359 CPU-second training receipt covers R12 controller fitting, not all earlier content-backbone training.
Tariff dominance does not imply lower CPU, calibrated values, stronger content learning, full financial-HX dynamics, natural-media generalization or energy advantage.
